mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_deletion_request (id, user_id, request_id, acknowledged, status, blockers_json, cooldown_days, effective_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{requestId}, #{acknowledged}, #{status}, #{blockersJson, javaType=String, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cooldownDays}, #{effectiveAt}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, request_id AS requestId, status, cancel_request_id AS cancelRequestId, cooldown_days AS cooldownDays, effective_at AS effectiveAt, canceled_at AS canceledAt, executed_at AS executedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM user_deletion_request WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, request_id AS requestId, status, cancel_request_id AS cancelRequestId, cooldown_days AS cooldownDays, effective_at AS effectiveAt, canceled_at AS canceledAt, executed_at AS executedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM user_deletion_request WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE user_deletion_request SET status = 'CANCELED', canceled_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), cancel_request_id = #{cancelRequestId}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE user_deletion_request SET status = 'CANCELED', canceled_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), blockers_json = #{blockersJson}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE user_deletion_request SET status = 'ACCEPTED', executed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
